meta.title: Sample brief
meta.question: Which of our largest accounts need a leader to step in this week, and why?
meta.listTitle: Where to step in this week

scope.label: Included
scope.value: Open renewals on paying accounts. Fictional data for previews and tests.

summary: Two accounts need a leader this week; both have gone quiet since a change of decision-maker.
Most of the book looks steady: four of six accounts are Medium or Low.

items.name: Northwind Analytics
items.subtitle: Owner: Dana Lee · Strategic
items.headline: New CFO is reviewing vendors; our champion left in October.
items.assessment: The person who championed us has left, and the new CFO has told the team every research vendor is under review. Nobody on their side has replied in 41 days, with the renewal four weeks away.

findings.finding: The champion left and no other contact has engaged since.

evidence.text: Out-of-office reply says the head of research has left the firm.

findings.finding: A new CFO started in September and is consolidating vendors.

evidence.text: Press release names a new CFO with a cost-reduction mandate.

findings.explanation: Checked 90 days of meetings and email summaries: no discount, budget or competitor mentions.

actions.title: Request a meeting with the new CFO
actions.why: The renewal decision now sits with someone we haven't met.
steps: Ask the remaining analyst for an introduction
Bring a one-page summary of usage this year

items.name: Contoso Capital
items.subtitle: Owner: Sam Ortiz · Focused
items.headline: Single-threaded and quiet for 52 days.
items.assessment: Only one person at Contoso has replied to us this quarter, and they have been silent for 52 days. Nothing suggests they plan to leave, but the renewal rests on one relationship.

findings.finding: No two-way contact in 52 days; two follow-ups unanswered.

evidence.text: Last meeting held: quarterly review with the portfolio manager.
Second follow-up sent by the owner; no reply captured.

actions.title: Ask a strategist to offer a portfolio review
actions.why: A reason to talk that isn't the renewal, and a second contact.
